test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A thief noticed a policeman from a distance of 300 m and started to run at a speed of 12 km/h. The policeman chased at a speed of 13 km/h and he caught the thief. What was the distance run by the thief?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance between thief and policeman = 300 m

Speed of thief = 12 km/h = 12000 m/h

Speed of policeman = 13 km/h = 13000 m/h

**Formula used:**

Time taken by policeman to catch the thief = dfrac{{Initial Distance}}{{Relative Speed}}</p
